svg.title: How IBM MaaS360 manages and protects devices
svg.desc: Three steps on one line. Manage: endpoint management across mobile devices and laptops, all from a single console. Defend: protection against malware, man-in-the-middle and phishing attacks, with near real-time response on the device. Decide: built-in Watson AI for endpoint security and management decisions.
